profiles.purpose: Build a static site and publish it under /apps/<app-name>/.
profiles.limitations: Publishes a static directory. Does not start a Node.js server or a container.

profiles.purpose: Package a Node.js server, publish it under /apps/<app-name>/, restart a systemd unit, and health-check it.
profiles.limitations: Does not provision Caddy or host routing. Requires systemd_unit and healthcheck_url. Application data stays in /apps/<app-name>/shared/.

profiles.purpose: Package Next.js standalone output, publish it under /apps/<app-name>/, restart a systemd unit, and health-check it.
profiles.limitations: Assembles standalone output plus static assets. Does not provision Caddy or host routing. Requires systemd_unit and healthcheck_url.

capabilities.purpose: Tag-styled af-theme, af-heading, and af-panel elements, plus the shared colour, space, and type tokens.
capabilities.integration: After publication, pnpm add @app-framework/ui. Import @app-framework/ui and @app-framework/ui/styles.css from a client component and call defineAppElements() inside useEffect.

compatibility.notes: Any JavaScript application. Independent of the deploy profile. Registry install waits until the npm scope is confirmed and this package is published.

capabilities.purpose: Typed environment values, with server-only values kept out of browser-safe output.
capabilities.integration: After publication, pnpm add @app-framework/app-config. Call defineConfig, loadConfig, and loadPublicConfig from application code.

compatibility.notes: Any JavaScript application. Independent of the deploy profile. Registry install waits until the npm scope is confirmed and this package is published.

capabilities.purpose: framework doctor, adopt, modules, add, upgrade, and deploy enable manage integration. framework-check and framework-setup remain aliases.
capabilities.integration: After publication, pnpm add -D @app-framework/dev-tools and run framework adopt. Until then, run the built CLI from a checkout of this repository.

compatibility.notes: Any JavaScript application. Independent of the deploy profile. Registry install waits until the npm scope is confirmed and this package is published.

capabilities.purpose: Shared Cursor rules for naming, separation, TypeScript, organisation, testing, and maintainability.
capabilities.integration: framework adopt and framework upgrade copy standards/cursor/rules into .cursor/rules/framework and write .cursor/framework-standards.json.

compatibility.notes: Any JavaScript application. Rules outside .cursor/rules/framework stay in the application. The interface rule in this repository stays here.

capabilities.purpose: Publish a versioned release to /apps/<app-name>/ with symlink activation, optional systemd restart, health checks, and rollback.
capabilities.integration: A caller uses workflow_call on Clain-Apps/App-Framework/.github/workflows/deploy.yml@deploy-v1 or @main. It passes vars.VPS_HOST, vars.VPS_USER, and vars.DEPLOY_ROOT, plus secrets VPS_SSH_KEY and VPS_KNOWN_HOSTS. deploy-static.yml@main is a static compatibility wrapper. The frozen tag deploy-static-v1 is not moved. framework deploy enable writes the caller; adopt does not.

compatibility.notes: Opt-in. Adoption does not write a caller. static-web publishes files. node-server and next-standalone restart a systemd unit and health-check it. Caddy stays outside this workflow.

capabilities.purpose: Version and publish the framework packages with Changesets. Applications do not run this workflow.
capabilities.integration: The release workflow in this repository publishes after the npm scope is confirmed. Applications bump their own dependency ranges.

compatibility.notes: Runs in this repository. Setup rejects an application that selects it.
